risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware damage (e.g., overheating or screen burn-in).
risks.proof: A video of the console running a game for at least 10 minutes.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's 'System Information' screen showing the last update date.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or clone.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number sticker on the bottom of the console.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Photo of the console's bottom with the serial number and model number clearly visible.
Photo of the console with all accessories (controllers, cables, power brick) laid out.
Video of the console running a game to confirm it is functional.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
